Question 2
?

The velocity vector v=⟨u,v⟩ of a particle P at time t is given by v=⟨5t−8,2t2+4⟩. Calculate the acceleration vector a.

a
a=⟨−8,4⟩
b
a=⟨5,2⟩
c
a=⟨5,2t⟩
d
a=⟨5,4t⟩
e
a=⟨5t,2t2⟩
